description: Make a sheet on any maker page of the site, with any of its settings: calendars, planners and checklists, logs, graphic organizers (Venn diagram, KWL chart…), name tags and desk plates, raffle tickets, coupon books and hall passes, games (bracket, fortune teller, charades, would you rather), bubble letters and banners, lined, graph, dot and handwriting paper, multiplication, addition, division and hundreds charts, number lines, place value charts, fraction strips, sight word sheets, color by number, and every maker that has its own tool. Prefer a maker’s own make_* tool when it has one. Call describe_maker first to see a page’s settings.

items.description: The maker’s typed list (describe_maker says what it is), one entry each.

names.description: Optional names, one sheet each, for makers that take names (name tags, certificates, word searches, charts; first names are enough). Shown and printed in the chat only: the link never carries names, so a person opening it types them on the page.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, the default; US and Canada) or a4 (everywhere else).

seed.description: Which random version to make. Leave out for a fresh one; pass the seed from an earlier result to keep that version while changing other settings.

settings.description: Address keys and values to change, exactly as describe_maker lists them.

title.description: The title printed on the sheet, where the maker prints one.

name: make_printable

maker.description: Which maker drew it, e.g. wordSearch

notes.description: Things worth knowing about this sheet

playUrl.description: Where a child can solve it on a screen (word search, crossword, maze, sudoku)

seed.description: The seed that rebuilds this exact sheet

settings.description: The address settings, as the maker reads them

url.description: The sheet on printablesmith.com, every setting filled in: open it to adjust, download the PDF or print

title: Make any printable
